features.featureTitle: Update the BulkProductUpload component (frontend/src/components/BulkProductUpload.tsx) to set the default selected template in the template dropdown to the 'Default' template (from REQ-136) when the component first loads, replacing the previously hardcoded description string. When the user changes the selected template from the dropdown, all product description fields that have not been manually edited should update to display the newly selected template's content. The four shape-specific templates (Turtle, Dolphin, Frog, Whale) must appear as selectable options in the same dropdown alongside the Default template.
